Use case: stylized-concept. Production art for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0, Stage 4, Shadar Logoth. Asset story4_panel_2.png. Canvas exactly 1280×720. Single image, not a sprite sheet. Fully opaque. HOUSE STYLE, identical to spike-art/HOUSE_STYLE.txt: HOUSE STYLE (Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0), identical for every image:
- Hand-drawn HD 2D fighting-game sprite art in the spirit of Streets of Rage 4: confident dark-brown/near-black ink outlines (thicker on the outer silhouette, thinner inside), clean cel shading with 2-3 tone steps plus subtle painterly gradients. NOT pixel art, NOT 3D render, NOT photo-real, NOT chibi.
- Lighting baked lightly: soft key light from the upper LEFT, gentle cool rim on the right edge. Keep shading moderate (the game adds real-time light on top).
- Rich but grounded colors. Strong readable silhouette.
- Side view (profile / slight 3/4), character faces RIGHT, full body head to boots, whole figure inside the frame with margin.
- Genuinely TRANSPARENT background (real alpha). No ground shadow, no floor, no text, no labels, no borders, no frame numbers. Story panel. Riley stands at the Gate of Aridhol, ribbon clenched in his fist, looking in. He is on-model. The broken arch frames him. Opaque painting, 1280×720. ON-MODEL RILEY: Riley is 16, very muscular, short dark hair, thin blue-framed glasses, sleeveless black Asha'man coat; never a kid. Attach the Riley master + riley.jpg. Follow spike-art/RILEY_SPEC.txt. Attach the Riley master (spike/gen/riley/master-side.png) and riley.jpg. No text, letters, numbers, watermarks, frame labels, or borders in the finished image. No gore: Shadowspawn become ash; human cultists are knocked out or flee.
